The '''Kloodavia system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kloodavian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="EpisodeIAdventures" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kloodavia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
